items.html: Yet the two lower segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin, which are the aspect of the arms joined to the two shoulders, remained for the portion of ZA and become a soul for him; and these are called the two coronets. And these descended below, and both were formed in the secret of the third brain of Daat of ZA, comprising Hesed and Gevura, which are the two segments mentioned. And since the two coronets are from the two lower segments, while the Hochma and Bina within him were drawn from the two upper segments, therefore the place of Daat is beneath Hochma and Bina.
